model_output.verdict: An experienced welder and fitter with precise shop work, pipe experience and a standout inspection record.
write_up: This is a strong welding resume! Your structural steel and pipe work comes with the processes, materials and standards a recruiter needs to see. The current Welder / Fitter role also shows both fit-up precision and inspection performance.

The Riverfront Tower line is the model: it names the job, the inspections and about 900 welds. Your certifications are easy to find, and the move from helper to pipe welder to fitter is easy to follow.
Let's give the shutdown line the same substance by naming the work you did there. Your resume doesn't need a major rebuild; the requirements of each job and the competition will matter too.

cards.line: - Worked nights and weekends on plant shutdowns
cards.cannot_tell: The schedule shows your availability, but not what you did during the shutdowns. Name the work you handled so a recruiter can connect it to the pipe jobs above.
cards.example: Worked nights and weekends on plant shutdowns, handling [shutdown work]
cards.question: What work did you handle during the plant shutdowns?

cards.line: - Passed every third-party UT and visual inspection on the Riverfront Tower job (about 900 welds)
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this. It gives a recruiter a named project and a clear way to understand your inspection record. Use that combination when another job has a result you can document.

cards.line: - Train new hires on the shop's fit-up and tacking procedures
cards.cannot_tell: Training new hires is a useful starting point for a lead role. If you've also coordinated welding work or helped set procedures, that would show more of the responsibility a lead job asks for.
cards.example: Train new hires on the shop's fit-up and tacking procedures and [additional responsibility coordinating welding work]
cards.question: Have you coordinated other welders' work or helped set shop procedures, and what did you do?

fit.why: Your current Welder / Fitter role names structural welding, drawing interpretation, fit-up and inspection work.
fit.level: Experienced welder / fitter who trains new hires
fit.note: Your resume points to structural welding and fit-up, with process piping as another direction. The certifications and inspection record give both paths useful detail.
